messages:
liam_sales: Quick handoff for Nimbus Health — sale signed last week. key facts: 50k mo tokens, starts onboarding Mon 2024-04-15, wants SSO + private VPC. Renewal in 11 months (annual).

liam_sales: Context/risks: customer is excited but timeline slipped 2x because of security review; they flagged data residency and audit logs as must-haves. Pricing agreed but CSM needs to move fast or renewal sentiment could drop. :warning:

maya_cs: Thanks — I can take lead. Can we get a short doc with current security answers and the signed SOW?

liam_sales: attaching links: <https://drive.redwood/teams/nimbus/sow.pdf> and security summary in the thread. also flagged legal question about subprocessor list (see comment 3).

kevin_eng: I can own the SSO connector + VPC network setup. Need customer IdP metadata and egress IP allowlist. when can they provide?

maya_cs: I'll request IdP metadata in kickoff. planning a 30m kickoff Tues 4/16. can kevin do 10–10:30am PT?

kevin_eng: yes 10–10:30 PT works. also: for private deploy we need approximate dataset size (GB) and expected peak seq len for throughput tuning.

maya_cs: noted — nimbus provided preliminary data volume ~120GB, peak seq len ~4k tokens. adding to kickoff agenda.

shreya_enablement: I'll prepare a 1-hr enablement: platform basics + token cost walkthrough + best practices for caching. will include a short checklist for devs. Maya, want me to run this the week after kickoff?

maya_cs: please. target Wed 4/24 for enablement. also planning weekly cadence: Mon status sync (15m) + ops channel.

liam_sales: FYI renewal risk score = medium-high based on timeline + security needs. flagging upsell: they asked about dedicated capacity later this year. Keep that in notes. :memo:

maya_cs: Action owners summary: Maya = onboarding lead + weekly sync; Kevin = SSO/VPC + etag connector; Shreya = enablement session; Liam = escalation for contract/legal. I'll open Tickets in Jira and add owners.

maya_cs: Quick open question for eng: Do we have a standard template for private VPC runbook to share? makes legal faster if they see the flow.

kevin_eng: We have a template — I'll paste the runbook link in the Jira ticket and attach network diagram.

onboard-bot: Reminder created: "Nimbus Health kickoff" 2024-04-16 10:00 PT. Jira ticket CS-4982 created and assigned to maya_cs, kevin_eng, shreya_enablement.

maya_cs: Thanks. I'll capture feedback during enablement and send a one-pager to Product for any platform gaps (onboarding pain points).

liam_sales: I'll stand by for legal questions. happy to join kickoff for intro. :thumbsup:

maya_cs: Next steps (short): 1) Maya to request IdP metadata + dataset confirmation by EOD 4/12; 2) Kevin to prepare runbook + attach in CS-4982 by 4/15; 3) Shreya to draft enablement deck by 4/20; 4) Kickoff 4/16 10am PT. I'll update the weekly sync invite after kickoff.

maya_cs: tagging owners here @kevin_eng @shreya_enablement @liam_sales — please confirm and flag blockers.
